name: Cursor
verdict: Docs still list Pro at $20, Pro Plus at $60, and Ultra at $200, but the public pricing page shows a different bundled lineup.
cons: The public pricing page does not match the docs
Usage past the included pool is pay-as-you-go
pricingNote: Unconfirmed, docs-sourced. On 2026-10-14, cursor.com/pricing (HTTP 200, title "Cursor · Pricing", no redirect) did not list Pro, Pro Plus, or these dollar amounts. It listed Free $0/month, Plus $8/month, Premium $30/month, Super $100/month, Ultra $200/month, and Teams $30+/user/month, mixed with Grok and X features, so those tiers are not shown here. The prices above are quoted from cursor.com/docs/models-and-pricing, which cursor.com/docs/account/pricing redirects to: "Pro $20/mo", "Pro Plus $60/mo", "Ultra $200/mo".
